reconstructed_statement: For every type α in universe u, every type β in universe v equipped with Fintype β, every real polynomial p, every natural number d satisfying p.natDegree ≤ d, and every row : α → ℝ and col : β → ℝ, set M(x,y)=p(row(x)+col(y)). Three assertions hold together. (1) For all x ∈ α and y ∈ β, M(x,y)=Σ_{i=0}^{d} ([X^i]p(X+row(x))) · col(y)^i. (2) There exist real matrices A indexed by α × Fin(d+1) and B indexed by Fin(d+1) × β such that M=AB, with (AB)(x,y)=Σ_{i∈Fin(d+1)} A(x,i)B(i,y). (3) The real dimension of the image of the linear map T_M : ℝ^β → ℝ^α given by (T_M v)(x)=Σ_{y∈β} M(x,y)v(y) is at most d+1. This is the supplied Matrix.rank M, namely Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.range M.mulVecLin).

semantic_slots.degree_hypothesis_and_zero: The condition is p.natDegree ≤ d, not equality and not a nonzero-polynomial assumption. The added normalized interface states natDegree(0)=0, so the zero polynomial satisfies the degree hypothesis for every natural d.
semantic_slots.expansion_indices: The sum is over exactly Fin(d+1), with each index coerced to its natural value i=0,...,d for both coefficient extraction and the exponent. d=0 is permitted.
semantic_slots.factorization: FactorsThrough α β (Fin(d+1)) means the existence of the two real matrices A and B with exact equality M=A*B. It does not assert a least possible factor dimension. The scalar expansion displays the candidate entries A(x,i)=[X^i]p(X+row(x)) and B(i,y)=col(y)^i, although the existential conjunct itself does not name witnesses.
semantic_slots.logical_shape: The conclusion is a conjunction of a universal scalar identity, an existential exact factorization, and a natural-number rank upper bound.
semantic_slots.nonemptiness_and_finiteness: Neither α nor β is required to be nonempty, and α need not be finite. If either is empty, the displayed matrix has zero-dimensional image. The intermediate index Fin(d+1) is finite and nonempty for every natural d.
semantic_slots.quantifiers_and_universes: α : Type u and β : Type v are independent arbitrary index types. p, d, the evidence hd of p.natDegree ≤ d, row, and col are universally quantified. Only β has a Fintype assumption; no separate DecidableEq or Nonempty assumption occurs in the target.
semantic_slots.rank_map_and_dimension: The new normalized interface explicitly gives M.mulVecLin on a coordinate vector v as x ↦ Σ_y M(x,y)v(y). Its image is the real span of the columns of M, viewed as functions α → ℝ. Since β is finite, this image is finite-dimensional even if α is infinite. Thus finrank here is an ordinary finite real vector-space dimension.
